patterns: Dominant shape is work-author or inscription-ruler matching: Rajatarangini-Kalhana, Si-Yu-Ki-Hiuen Tsang, Mudrarakshasa-Vishakhadatta, Hathigumpha-Kharavela, Junagadh-Rudradaman.
APPSC favourite trap: 'wrong pair' items (Rudradaman-Nanaghat 2012; I-Tsing-Ashoka 2018/2019) and composer vs king confusions.
AP tilt: Satavahana sources (Nasik, Naneghat, Gathasaptasati, Puranas), Megasthenes' 30 Andhra forts, Andhrapatha, first Telugu inscription (Kalamalla).
Other PSCs ask 'earliest' facts: Sohgaura famine order, Kavya style in Junagadh, Kharosthi right-to-left, Boghaz-Koi Vedic gods, Ardha-Magadhi Jain canon.
App MCQs are far more multi-statement and A-R heavy than PYQs, and drift into medieval/modern trivia (Andhra Shivaji, Shivaji, Kakatiya firsts).
